label: Late in episode: up at GO when S2 believed good, at D2 in S1, after reward at D1.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/16) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * np.exp(ep_trial/16) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/16)
terms: (phase == GO) * belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == GO) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D2) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/10)
explanation: Unit 14 candidate n sits near -1 for most of the episode and ramps steeply toward +0.4 over the last ~20 trials (timing R^2 0.88). Beyond timing, the modulations scale with that ramp (multiplying by exp(ep_trial/k) roughly doubles R^2 vs unscaled indicators): at GO it is higher when the ideal observer favours S2 as good (negative belief_lo; also after unrewarded trials and a2 choices), at D2 higher when S1 was reached, at D1 higher after a rewarded trial. Short form captures these three; the free fit adds within-decile ramp terms per phase (pure late-episode timing finer than the decile baseline) and GO-after-unrewarded / prev a2 terms, reaching ~0.34 dev. Choice/state reached at GO (future) adds little beyond belief.
